856.frame: viewer page 2 (middle opening; pages 1 and 3 are clear Italian)
856.saw: Italian letter, London 11 Jan 1555. Page 1 and 3 clear text; page 2 opening has several lines of numeric/sign cipher groups in the upper right with interlinear decipherment written above them (and a marginal gloss). Language Italian confirmed; ambassador of Ferrara.
856.note: Card: https://bnedigital.bne.es/bd/card?oid=0000172729&site=bdh. Title on the viewer: Carta de Antonio Maria di Saboya, embajador del Duque de Ferrara. Londres, 11 enero 1555. Only 3 images; folio_note said 3 folios.

857.saw: One-page letter dated Hostabrich 5 June 1473; about 9 central lines are cipher (signs/digit-like characters) with interlinear letter glosses above them in a different hand, rest clear Spanish; autograph signature of Ferdinand and seal remains. 857.note: Card: https://bnedigital.bne.es/bd/card?oid=0000186643&site=bdh. Did not open the full-size viewer image, so sign system detail is from the thumbnail.
